entries.title: JSCOE admission document checklist
questions: Which documents are required for admission?
What papers should I bring for admission?
How many photographs do I need for admission?
Do I need a gap certificate?
entries.answer:
The college checklist lists:
• CET/JEE scorecard; Class 12 and Class 10 marksheets; Class 10 passing certificate.
• Leaving certificate; birth certificate / domicile and nationality, if required.
• Caste certificate, caste validity and non-creamy-layer certificate.
• Mother-tongue certificate and MKB certificate.
• Two colour photographs; gap certificate, if required.
Category columns are not readable as requirements on the webpage. Ask admissions which conditional certificates apply to you; the bot cannot decide reservation eligibility.

entries.title: JSCOE admission process overview
questions: How do I apply for engineering admission?
entries.answer:
The posted admission guide describes this sequence:
1. Register online with the competent Maharashtra admission authority.
2. Complete document verification.
3. Check merit lists and resolve grievances.
4. Submit course and institute preferences in the option form.
5. Check seat allotment, accept the seat as applicable and report to the allotted institute to confirm admission.
The PDF is undated. Check the current CAP portal for the active schedule and round rules.

entries.title: JSCOE posted admission eligibility guide (undated)
questions: Can I apply with MHT CET or JEE Main?
What HSC subjects and minimum marks does the guide mention?
entries.answer: The undated guide mentions MHT-CET/JEE Main and HSC/equivalent with Physics and Mathematics plus a permitted additional subject. It states 45% qualifying marks for general and 40% for listed reserved categories, and mentions diploma lateral entry. These are the guide’s statements; verify the current CAP brochure before relying on eligibility.
